ideas.title: Minnesota Welfare Fraud: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: An investigation into the allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota and the role of officials in assisting in the fraud.
questions: What is the extent of the welfare fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the welfare fraud?
ideas.insight: The allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota raise concerns about the management of welfare programs in the state. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible.

ideas.title: Gateway Tunnel Funding: A Review of the Process
ideas.description: An investigation into the release of federal funds for the Gateway Tunnel project and the management of federal funds for infrastructure projects.
questions: What were the reasons for the freeze on funds for the Gateway Tunnel project?
What is the impact of the release of funds on the project?
ideas.insight: The freeze on funds for the Gateway Tunnel project raises questions about the management of federal funds for infrastructure projects. Further investigation is needed to determine the reasons for the freeze and the impact on the project.
